notes: PAPER LICENCE: CC BY 4.0; Europe PMC records licence 'cc by' for PMC9918545 and Unpaywall reports oa_status 'gold' with a cc-by publisher location. PDF archived. DATA LICENCE, separate: not stated in the article text. The paper says only 'COG-BCI is available on Zenodo' and cites the deposit as 10.5281/zenodo.6874128 (COG-BCI database, 2022). Zenodo requires a licence per record but the record's licence field was not read at retrieval time, so the data licence is recorded as unknown and must be checked on the Zenodo landing page before redistribution. A predecessor deposit by the same authors, 10.5281/zenodo.5055046, holds the 2021 Neuroergonomics Conference passive-BCI competition dataset, which is a different and smaller release -- do not conflate the two. YEAR AND CITATION: Crossref dates the article 2023-02-10 in Scientific Data volume 10, but the DOI suffix reads s41597-022-..., which reflects acceptance in 2022. The card and bib use 2023. TITLE: note the article's own irregular capitalisation, 'Open multi-session and multi-task EEG cognitive Dataset for passive brain-computer Interface Applications', reproduced verbatim in the bib. EXTRACTION: source.md built from the Europe PMC full-text XML. md_quality is rough -- the article has a large number of figures (26 are referenced) and several tables including the task-order table and the per-task validation statistics, all of which flatten into run-on text or survive only as captions. Crucially, Fig. 6, which is the channel-location diagram, is the authoritative record of which electrode is where and reduces to a caption; the TP9-for-ECG and Fpz-reference facts quoted on the card come from the surrounding prose, which states them explicitly, and were read back against source.pdf. EXTRACTION UPDATE 2026-08-01 -- source.md was regenerated with pymupdf4llm, which preserves markdown tables and inter-word spacing that the earlier markitdown conversion destroyed, and md_quality was reassessed against the new extraction as clean (was rough).
